abstract: The seller seeks to sell two different items by bundling participation. Membership allows only members to buy either item or both. A membership mechanism thus specifies a member set and a fee as well as allocation and payment rules. We first establish the revenue-maximizing mechanism given a modified valuation distribution incorporating the member set, which also resolves the existence problem. The optimal membership mechanism enables us to compare between bundling participation and separate participation, suggesting conditions under which membership dominates selling two goods separately: interplay between the number of bidders and the degree of the stochastic dominance of valuation distributions. This mechanism also provides a rationale for secret reserve prices, a long-standing puzzle in theory.
abstract_zh: 卖方试图通过捆绑参与来销售两种不同的物品。会员资格仅允许会员购买其中任一物品或两者兼有。因此，会员机制规定了会员集合、费用以及分配和支付规则。我们首先在考虑会员集合的修正估值分布下，确立了收益最大化的机制，这也解决了存在性问题。最优会员机制使我们能够比较捆绑参与与单独参与，提出了会员制优于分别销售两种商品的条件：竞标者数量与估值分布随机优势程度之间的相互作用。该机制还为秘密保留价这一理论中长期存在的谜题提供了合理解释。
title: Membership mechanism

title: In the Name of Love: Policy Imitation, Political Incentives, and Local Economic Growth
title_zh: 以爱之名：政策模仿、政治激励与地方经济增长

abstract: Whether every quasi-convex game has a population monotonic allocation scheme (PMAS) has been an open question for more than 30 years (Sprumont in Games Econ Behav 2:378–394, 1990). In this note, we provide an answer to this question negatively: namely, we exhibit a quasi-convex game that has no PMAS.
abstract_zh: 准凸博弈是否总具有人口单调分配方案（PMAS）这一问题已悬而未决超过30年（Sprumont，Games Econ Behav 2:378–394，1990）。在本注记中，我们对此问题给出否定答案：即，我们构造了一个不具有PMAS的准凸博弈。
title: A quasi-convex game without having population monotonic allocation scheme
title_zh: 不具有人口单调分配方案的拟凸博弈

abstract: In this paper, we extend the museum pass problem to incorporate the market structure. To be more precise, we consider that museums are organized into several pass programs or consortia. Within this framework, we propose four allocation mechanisms based on the market structure and the principles of proportionality and egalitarianism. Each mechanism satisfies a distinct set of reasonable properties related to fairness and stability, which serve to axiomatically characterize them. Similar content being viewed by others
abstract_zh: 本文将博物馆通票问题拓展至市场结构层面。具体而言，我们考虑博物馆被组织为多个通票项目或联盟。在此框架下，基于市场结构以及比例原则与平等主义原则，我们提出了四种分配机制。每种机制均满足一组与公平性和稳定性相关的合理性质，这些性质构成了对其的公理化刻画。
title: The museum pass problem with consortia
title_zh: 博物馆通票的联盟问题

abstract: This study examines how controlling misinformation on a social media platform in Pakistan affects users’ exposure to both accurate and false information. It combines an intervention to disseminate official information about the COVID-19 pandemic across the platform with a randomized experiment that measures the impact of fully controlling access to pandemic-related misinformation. The treatments rely on a higher-intensity, ex ante approach to moderating misinformation on the platform relative to the control, which relies on a typical ex post approach to moderation. Fully controlling misinformation, as in the treatments, reduces the number of daily users by 19%, indicating a distaste for moderation. Furthermore, the treatments reduce exposure to official information by 29% more than they reduce exposure to misinformation. A conceptual framework posits that these findings can be explained by the fact that, in this setting, official information is more trusted, and thus is more widely disseminated, relative to misinformation.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在巴基斯坦的一个社交媒体平台上，控制错误信息如何影响用户接触准确信息与虚假信息的情况。该研究结合了一项干预措施，即在平台上传播关于COVID-19疫情的官方信息，以及一项随机实验，用以衡量完全控制疫情相关错误信息访问的影响。相较于对照组采用的典型事后审核方法，这些处理措施依赖于一种更高强度、事前的方法来审核平台上的错误信息。如处理组所示，完全控制错误信息使每日用户数量减少了19%，表明用户对审核存在反感。此外，处理措施在减少官方信息接触方面的效果比减少错误信息接触高出29%。一个概念框架提出，这些发现可以解释为，在此情境下，官方信息更受信任，因此相较于错误信息，其传播范围更广。
title: The spread of (mis)information: A social media experiment in Pakistan
title_zh: （错误）信息的传播：巴基斯坦的一项社交媒体实验

abstract: This article examines the welfare implications of third-party informational intermediation. A seller sets the price of a product that is sold through an intermediary, who discloses information about the product to consumers. In a model where the intermediary is consumer-minded—has a payoff that depends on both the seller's revenue and the consumer surplus, we show that total welfare may decrease in the Pareto sense, as the intermediary's consumer-mindedness increases. Furthermore, we show that consumer-mindedness emerges endogenously when a revenue-maximizing intermediary is forward-looking and the consumer base is increasing in past consumer surplus.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了第三方信息中介的福利影响。卖方设定通过中介销售的产品价格，中介向消费者披露产品信息。在模型中，中介以消费者为导向——其收益同时取决于卖方收入和消费者剩余，我们证明，随着中介消费者导向程度的提高，总福利可能在帕累托意义上下降。此外，我们表明，当追求收入最大化的中介具有前瞻性，且消费者基数随过去消费者剩余增加时，消费者导向会内生地出现。
title: Consumer‐Minded Informational Intermediary and Welfare Losses
title_zh: 消费者导向的信息中介与福利损失

abstract: This article studies a dynamic project-selection game between a Principal and an Agent with conflicting interests. Only the Agent knows what projects are feasible. In each period before a project is selected, the Principal imposes a restriction set. The Agent can select any feasible project within this set, thereby ending the game. The Agent can also stay silent, in which case the game will proceed to the next period. Importantly, the Principal cannot commit to her future restriction sets. I show that when the Agent is sufficiently patient, the Principal fully delegates to the Agent in the unique equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个委托人与代理人之间利益冲突的动态项目选择博弈。只有代理人知晓哪些项目是可行的。在每个项目被选定之前的每个时期，委托人施加一个限制集合。代理人可以在该集合内选择任何可行的项目，从而结束博弈。代理人也可以保持沉默，在这种情况下，博弈将进入下一时期。重要的是，委托人无法承诺其未来的限制集合。我证明，当代理人足够有耐心时，在唯一均衡中，委托人会将决策权完全委托给代理人。
title: Full Discretion is Inevitable
title_zh: 完全自由裁量权不可避免

abstract: The trade-off between market power and efficiency gains is central to antitrust analyses of mergers, but empirical evidence quantifying efficiencies remains limited. Using transaction-level data from U.S. freight railroads (1985–2005), this article quantifies merger-induced cost efficiencies, driven mainly by eliminating inter-railroad interchange costs and reoptimization of routing and resource allocation within integrated networks. I develop a spatial equilibrium model with oligopolistic competition to assess equilibrium merger effects. Counterfactual analyses show mergers reduce shipment costs by 12.9% and prices by 8.8%. Markups increase by 7.2%, driven primarily by non-merging firms reallocating resources away from regions where merged firms achieve large cost reductions.
abstract_zh: 市场势力与效率提升之间的权衡是并购反垄断分析的核心问题，但量化效率的实证证据仍然有限。利用美国货运铁路的微观交易数据（1985-2005年），本文量化了并购带来的成本效率，这些效率主要源于消除铁路间换装成本以及整合网络内路线和资源配置的重新优化。我构建了一个包含寡头竞争的空间均衡模型，以评估并购的均衡效应。反事实分析显示，并购使运输成本降低12.9%，价格下降8.8%。加成率上升7.2%，主要驱动因素是非并购企业将资源从并购企业实现大幅成本降低的区域重新配置出去。
title: Network Structure and the Efficiency Gains from Mergers: Evidence from U.S. Freight Railroads
title_zh: 网络结构与并购效率收益：来自美国货运铁路的证据

abstract: Confounding events can cause false positives when testing the relationship between short-term returns around a quasi-experimental event and firm characteristics. We show that this risk is severe in practice — return-characteristic relationships are often statistically significant at the 1% level on over 30% of all trading days. Benchmarking a relationship against the distribution of the same relationship on pre-event days is effective at addressing the problem. We introduce a novel GLS variation of this approach that achieves large gains in statistical power relative to OLS and provide Stata and Python modules that implement both procedures.
abstract_zh: 混淆事件在检验准实验事件前后短期收益与企业特征之间的关系时，可能导致假阳性结果。我们表明，这一风险在实践中十分严重——在超过30%的所有交易日中，收益与特征之间的关系通常在1%显著性水平上具有统计显著性。将某一关系与事件前日期的同一关系分布进行基准比较，能有效解决此问题。我们引入了一种新颖的GLS变体方法，相较于OLS，在统计功效上实现了大幅提升，并提供Stata和Python模块以实施这两种程序。
title: Past is prologue: Inference from the cross section of returns around an event
title_zh: 过去即是序幕：事件前后横截面收益的推断

abstract: We study the labor market and macroeconomic effects of carbon taxation in the energy sector in emerging economies. We build a macro-search model with pollution externalities, endogenous green-energy adoption, salaried-firm entry, and endogenous self-employment. The carbon tax increases green technology adoption in the energy sector and the share of green energy. Under a baseline revenue recycling scheme that transfers the carbon tax revenue to households, the tax raises energy prices, leading to a reduction in salaried firm and job creation, and an increase in self-employment and labor force participation that ultimately generate welfare and GDP losses. Additional model experiments show that the presence of self-employment as a distinct employment category significantly amplifies these losses. However, endogenous green technology adoption can drastically limit the magnitude of these losses. Using the carbon tax revenue to support green energy investment can deliver a decline in energy prices and net welfare and output gains while reducing self-employment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴经济体能源部门碳税对劳动力市场及宏观经济的影响。我们构建了一个包含污染外部性、内生绿色能源采用、受薪企业进入及内生自雇就业的宏观搜索模型。碳税提高了能源部门的绿色技术采用率及绿色能源占比。在将碳税收入转移给家庭的基准收入循环方案下，税收推高了能源价格，导致受薪企业和就业创造减少，同时自雇就业和劳动力参与率上升，最终造成福利和GDP损失。额外的模型实验表明，自雇就业作为独立就业类别的存在显著放大了这些损失。然而，内生的绿色技术采用能大幅限制这些损失的规模。利用碳税收入支持绿色能源投资，可实现能源价格下降、净福利和产出增长，同时减少自雇就业。
title: Climate policies, labor markets, and macroeconomic outcomes in emerging economies
title_zh: 新兴经济体的气候政策、劳动力市场与宏观经济结果
